messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: High OOM rate on prod-gpu-pool-3 (region-us-west) - 15 OOMs in last 10m, autoscaler triggered a scale-up. Severity: P2

maya: seeing same. dashboard shows slow memory creep on several model-serving containers, not immediate spikes. paging activity climbing.

samir: logs look like paged-attn allocator fragmentation + kvcache growth. stack traces repeatedly: `CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY` then allocator logs: 
```
allocator: freed 0x7f3a8b0000 -> size 65536, free_lists: 0x3f2/0x10/frag=0.78
kv_cache: page orphaned: id=0x3f2 entries=12 free=4
paged-alloc: can't coalesce buddy: run_id=8792
```

elaine: quick check - any recent model rollouts or quantization changes? deploy-bot: deploy 2026-06-09T01:12:03 -> model/bert-24q (canary)

maya: that canary started ~01:12, timeline matches. but the crash pattern predates canary by ~30m on some nodes. looks like slow fragmentation + occasional big-request burns through remaining contiguous pages.

samir: reproducer idea: run long chat workload with many prefix cache entries and frequent memory pressure to force fragmentation. but can't repro locally easily due to different page allocator settings.

alice: customer impact? any 5xxs seen by front door?

maya: yes, customer telemetry shows elevated 500s for some customers pinned to us-west-gpu-3. Affected: internal-prod-batch (non-critical), partner-x real-time (timeout errors). 

ryan: created a temporary routing rule to send partner-x to fallback region us-east while we mitigate. Applied at LB level 02:05. partner-x confirmed reduced errors.

elaine: can we evict the kvcache on the affected nodes to reclaim contiguous space? risk: some latencies will spike as cache warms.

samir: we have a runtime flag `--kvcache-evict-strategy=aggressive` we can toggle. plan: flip flag on one pilot node, monitor OOMs. command: `rdctl node-config set prod-gpu-3-17 --env KVCACHE_EVICT=aggressive`

maya: doing pilot now on node prod-gpu-3-17. starting warmdown of long-running sessions.

infra-bot: NOTE: cordon prod-gpu-3-17 at 02:22 by maya for safe restart.

maya: pv logs just before restart: 
```
[02:21:48] kv_cache: allocation failed for page_size=131072, available_contig=65536
[02:21:48] paged-alloc: fragmentation_ratio=0.81, total_free=1.6GB
[02:21:49] runtime: CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY (alloc 128MB)
```

samir: after setting evict, memory dropped on 3-17 from 93% -> 45% over 90s. no new OOMs on that node since 02:23. good signal.

maya: rolling config to two more nodes (prod-gpu-3-18, prod-gpu-3-19) with 30s stagger.

deploy-bot: config rollout started: job/kv-evict-rollout id=jm-4982.

ryan: monitoring aggregated OOM count, it dropped cluster-wide from 15/10m -> 4/10m after first three nodes. still some residual at 03:05.

elaine: suggestion: patch allocator to coalesce smaller free lists more aggressively, but that's a code change for later. short-term we should continue evict strategy + drain high-variance sessions.

samir: also saw a leak in page metadata: `kv_cache: page_meta leak detected id=0x4fa refs=0` - suspicious. added local tracer to track refcounts.

maya: handoff: I'm going offline in 20m. leaving list of open actions.

maya: OPEN ACTIONS:
- keep `KVCACHE_EVICT=aggressive` on prod-gpu-3 pool until next maintenance window (ops)
- run nightly batch that forces coalescence and then restart allocator to clear metadata leaks (eng-runtime/samir)
- add temporary LB routing for partner-x (ryan done)
- gather sample heap+kvcache dumps from 3 nodes for postmortem (maya/samir)

samir: I'll collect heap dumps (sampling) and push to /mnt/incident-dumps/1778883333/ by 03:30. note: dumps are ~1.2GB each.

alice: customer comms: notified partner-x engineering and they acknowledged temporary routing and will monitor. ops tracker updated.

infra-bot: scheduled restart of prod-gpu-3-20 at 03:45 for maintenance window (to reclaim fragmented memory).

maya: quick note about mitigations tried and results compiled into the incident doc: /docs/incidents/1778883333-fragging-nightshift.md (draft). please add your notes.

elaine: can we add a regression alert for `fragmentation_ratio > 0.7 && oom_rate > 3/10m`? would catch earlier.

samir: good call — I'll add to alerting and test thresholds.

ryan: day shift handoff to @elaine @alice: key risk still not fully resolved: allocator metadata leak. reproducer pending. we should avoid large single-request batch sizes in us-west until code fix.

maya: handing to you @elaine in 15. i'm leaving contactable on pager if needed. good job everyone on the quick routing workaround. :thumbsup:

elaine: thanks maya. I'll continue monitoring and coordinate with eng-runtime for a patch. handoff note copied to #eng-runtime.

samir: uploading tracer logs now. link: https://s3.redwood.company/incident-dumps/1778883333/tracer-log.tar.gz

alice: I'll follow up with partner-x PM and ops for a post-incident call tomorrow. adding to calendar.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity downgraded to P3 at 03:20; OOM rate reduced. Please close this thread when remediation tasks are in tracking.

elaine: closing notes: keep `KVCACHE_EVICT=aggressive` until we have a safe allocator coalescing patch, run dump analysis, and implement alert. will update incident doc with timelines.

ryan: last check 03:40: OOMs = 1/30m, fragmentation_ratio median = 0.52. marking as stabilized.

maya: thanks all, great coordination.
